Stamp loyalty cards in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet without an app

Features include stamps, tiers or points, customizable card designs, lock screen messages to encourage returns, Google review requests, and a dashboard showing customer activity. Ideal for cafés, bakeries, restaurants, beauty salons, and neighborhood shops. Offers a 30-day free trial.

HARDER
Photo-proof habit challenges with social accountability
HARDER is a habit and challenge platform that replaces self-reported checkboxes with photo or video proof. Users can choose from 177 pre-built challenges across 19 categories or create their own, from daily actions like reading for 10 minutes to multi-part challenges lasting months. Instead of resetting a streak after a missed day, the system counts a reduced "floor-level" effort the same as a full one. Spaces, feeds, and public profiles offer social accountability, with private options to share proof only within a chosen circle. When a challenge ends, HARDER creates a shareable recap card showing a calendar of every day with submitted photos.

TaskPocket
Capture tasks in seconds and see only what matters today
My favorite to-do app was Apple-only, and work gave me a Windows laptop. The alternatives I tried came with boards, labels, filters, AI assistants, and team workspaces. I spent more time setting them up than doing the work, so I built my own.
TaskPocket is small on purpose: it has an inbox, projects, and areas that group projects. There's nothing to configure. You type tasks the way you'd say them: "water the plants every other Saturday at 10am" sets the date, the repeat, and a reminder.
No AI inside, but there's a public API and an MCP server, so you can connect Claude or ChatGPT to your tasks. It works on any browser and iPhone. No teams or Android support yet. Free plan, no card needed.

Marsell
Create content, run marketing, and find buyers on autopilot
Marsell runs content, marketing, and sales on autopilot for solo founders and small to medium businesses. It learns your business, voice, and visual style, then plans and creates posts, articles, emails, images, carousels, films, and landing pages. It publishes to connected channels, finds prospects, and prepares outreach and follow-ups. Teams can share organizations with admin, editor, and viewer roles, inspect the work, and keep selected actions for approval. Paid plans start at $49/month. Try the interactive demo: https://getmarsell.com/app/demo
